mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id AS conversationId, COUNT(*) AS messageCount, MAX(created_at) AS lastTime, (SELECT c2.content FROM ai_chat_memory c2 WHERE c2.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND c2.message_type = 'USER' ORDER BY c2.created_at ASC LIMIT 1) AS firstMessage FROM ai_chat_memory m WHERE (user_id = #{userId} OR conversation_id LIKE CONCAT('%:', #{userId}, ':%')) GROUP BY conversation_id ORDER BY lastTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
